question: Which of the following is NOT one of the Grand Slam tournaments of tennis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canadian Open.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**Grand Slam tournaments of tennis

__
 
• The achievement of winning all four major championships in one discipline in the same calendar year.
 
• Four major championships:** the championships of Australia, France, Britain (Wimbledon), and the United States.**
 
• The tournaments are overseen by the** International Tennis Federation (ITF).**
 
• The Grand Slam is important in terms of** world ranking points, tradition, prize-money awarded, and public attention**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The four Grand Slam tournaments (with each played over two weeks) are the** **

 
 
• **Australian Open in January**,
 
• **French Open from late May to early June**,
 
• **Wimbledon in late June to early July,** and
 
• **US Open in August–September**
 
 
 
• **The Australian and the United States** tournaments are played on **hard courts**, **the French on clay**, and **Wimbledon on grass.**​​
